dismissed.why_not_material: This is a minor timeline slip on the catalyst trial itself. The company guided early 2024 in Dec 2023 while the registry showed completion Oct-Dec 2023, and completion ultimately slipped to Dec 2023. This reflects normal operational slippage in enrollment or follow-up timing, not masking of efficacy data. Timeline inconsistencies of this magnitude are common in phase 3 execution and do not constitute evidence of dishonesty about the underlying clinical results. The guidance was prospective and reasonably close to the actual registered dates.

analyst_note: The only refuted finding is a minor operational timeline discrepancy: KalVista guided 'early 2024' topline for sebetralstat in Dec 2023 while the NCT05259917 registry showed primary completion originally scheduled for Oct-Dec 2023. The registry completion date subsequently slipped to end-2023. This magnitude of slippage is typical phase 3 execution noise—enrollment pace, site activation, or follow-up logistics—and does not signal masking of clinical efficacy. No company-level honesty flags, no endpoint manipulation, no data misrepresentation. The pre-catalyst marketing is consistent with a sponsor running a clean pivotal trial where the biology is simply unknown.
